integrity: The proof uses the posterior information form, fixed trace of the rank-one information update, the exact trace-determinant formula for two-dimensional condition number, and the Rayleigh quotient. The unique isotropy and prior-worsening thresholds follow algebraically. An exact rational example is replayed independently by the embedded checker; finite computation is not used as the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic two-dimensional result for one scalar linear-Gaussian measurement with a continuously selectable unit sensing direction. It is an anisotropy statement, not a claim that more accurate data worsens statistical estimation. Higher-dimensional, discrete-sensor, dynamic-prediction, and non-Gaussian variants are outside scope.
title: Exact posterior-isotropy frontier for one scalar Kalman measurement
